# v0.2.3 persisted-state fixture

`events.jsonl` was generated by the tagged `v0.2.3` implementation at commit
`4cc71fa` (the release merge commit), not by current coordinator types. It
contains a version-1 checkpoint followed by a committed journal tail with:

- an active root and child;
- an assigned child task;
- an unacknowledged request/message pair; and
- a resource with a live mutable lease.

The Round 10 migration test boots the current broker against this directory,
verifies recovery and reconnect, and asserts that the broker replaces the
legacy checkpoint with persisted state version 2.
